Synopsis:
A rapidly spreading wildfire (Hawk Fire, 13,000+ acres) near Reno, Nevada forced ~42,000 residents to evacuate, with an additional 45,000 in warning zones. The fire threatened residential neighborhoods, the University of Nevada campus, and caused widespread power outages (~10,000 homes/businesses). A state of emergency was declared, National Guard mobilized, and ~400 firefighting personnel deployed. Several structures destroyed, 6 casualties (civilians + first responders). Logistical disruptions included road closures and a secondary airport shutdown.
